# Toffin Pakistan — Full Site Content

> Toffin Pakistan is a B2B supplier of premium coffee machines and integrated solutions for the HORECA (Hotel, Restaurant, Café) industry. Based in Islamabad, it serves cafés, restaurants, and hotels across Pakistan, under the Toffin HORECA partner brand established in 2007.

Last updated: 2026-10-05

**Legal name**: Toffin Pakistan
**Brand name**: Toffin

**Market served**: Cafés, restaurants, and hotels across Pakistan

## History & Position

Toffin has been a HORECA partner brand since 2007, built on one basic principle: every F&B business deserves access to internationally recognised coffee machines, backed by a reliable and professional service ecosystem.

Toffin Pakistan brings that approach to cafés, restaurants, and hotels across Pakistan from its office in Islamabad — connecting F&B businesses with world-class coffee machines, quality ingredients, a digital ordering platform, and experienced technicians and trainers.

---

## Values

### 1. Uncompromising Quality
Every product we distribute goes through strict curation. Toffin only recommends the best for its customers' businesses.

### 2. Sustainable Partnership
Toffin positions itself as a business partner, not just a supplier. Every relationship is built on long-term trust and accountable results.

### 3. Expertise
Toffin's technicians and baristas are trained on the equipment and brands it distributes, so customers receive professional, consistent service.

---

## Products & Services

### Coffee Machines & Equipment
- **Espresso Machines**: Official distribution of world-class coffee machine brands
- **Coffee Grinders**: Commercial grinders for cafés and roasteries
- **Other machines**: Brewing machines, milk frothers, and supporting F&B equipment

### F&B Ingredients
- Syrups, beverage powders, sachets, premixes
- Consumable supplies for the café & restaurant industry
- A strictly curated collection of premium ingredients

### Services
- Barista training
- Machine installation and calibration by trained technicians
- Regular servicing & maintenance
- After-sales support and warranty handling
- Genuine spare parts

---

## Toffin App — B2B Digital Platform

**Position**: A B2B digital platform designed specifically for the HORECA industry (not an adaptation of a generic app)
**Platform**: iOS & Android
**Price**: Free to download

### Key Features of Toffin App

1. **Personalized Order** — A personalised shopping feature with pre-agreed competitive prices on equipment and ingredients.

2. **AI Product Recommendations** — Product recommendations tailored to your business needs using AI technology.

3. **Service Credit** — Easily purchase services such as barista training, or call a technician for machine maintenance or repair. A deposit-style balance that can be topped up to buy products and services more economically.

4. **Interactive Consultation** — Choose an expert or sales representative to talk to via live chat. Ask about products and specifications, or get a free consultation via chat or video call.

5. **Toffin Personal AI Assistant** — A personal assistant feature for consulting on anything in the F&B world.

6. **Easy Tracking** — Live tracking to follow your order's journey.

7. **Warranty & Maintenance Service** — Shop with peace of mind, backed by maintenance and repair support from Toffin Pakistan. Every product sold is genuine.

8. **Toffin Points** — A loyalty points system. Every purchase in Toffin App earns points that can be used on future transactions.

---

## Support & After-Sales

Toffin's after-sales service covers coffee machine installation, calibration, and servicing by a team of trained technicians, with genuine spare parts and warranty support.

### FAQ — After-Sales Service

**Q: How do I report a machine issue?**
A: Contact Toffin Pakistan by phone/WhatsApp (+92 309 1115951), email (toffinpakistan@gmail.com), or the contact form. The team will arrange a technician.

**Q: Are genuine spare parts available?**
A: Yes, Toffin supplies genuine spare parts for the brands it distributes.

**Q: Is there a charge for a technician call-out?**
A: For machines still under warranty, technician visits incur no additional charge. For machines out of warranty, a visit and diagnosis fee applies and will be communicated before the technician arrives.

**Q: Does Toffin service machines from brands it does not distribute?**
A: For the best service, we focus on officially distributed brands. However, for some brands common in the industry, consultation and referral to the right technician are available. Contact us to discuss further.

**Q: How do I sign up for a maintenance package?**
A: Contact the sales team by phone, email, or the contact form. An account manager will review the condition of your machines and recommend the package best suited to the scale and needs of your business.

## Privacy Policy (Summary)

Toffin Pakistan handles personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws and regulations in Pakistan.

### Data Collected
- Full name, business name, email, phone number, and message content (from the contact form)
- Web interaction data (cookies, IP address, browser info) via analytics tools

### Purposes of Use
- Responding to customer inquiries
- Following up on business requirements you submit
- Sending relevant product information (with consent)
- Analytics to improve our services
- Data is not sold to third parties

### User Rights
- Right to access personal data
- Right to correct data
- Right to delete data
- Right to withdraw consent

**Data Protection Contact**: toffinpakistan@gmail.com (subject: "Privacy Request") or WhatsApp +92 309 1115951
